entry.title: Lucky Dip 0.9.2
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Lucky Dip 0.9.1
entry.summary: Skin now also in the MPC OS 2.x shape, so the catalog labels this release "MPC OS 2.x + 3.x" (library needs glibc 2.30; skin checked against MPC OS 2.15.1's own skins). - Tested on an Akai Force (MPC OS 3.9.1.x): all pages work. CPU bench PASS (worst p99 13.1%, worst block 27.6%). - **Not yet tried on a 2.x unit.** If you have an MPC Live / One / X on 2.x, please report whether it loads and draws. - Toolchain re-vendored from mpc-vst-plugins a4b8f86.

entry.title: Lucky Dip 0.9.0
entry.summary: # Lucky Dip 0.9.0 **A random drum-kit builder and inspiration machine for Akai MPC and Force.** It dips into your sample library, fills 16 pads at random, plays the kit, and exports it as an MPC drum program. Lock what you like, reroll what you don't, and rediscover samples you forgot you had.
